ABOUT THE ARCHIVE

Collect history. Explore context.

This is a free card collecting game about political history and ideas. The archive includes democratic leaders, political philosophers, activists, dictators, and figures associated with terrorism and political violence. Inclusion does not endorse their actions or beliefs.

Every packet costs 100 points. Complete a five-question history and packet knowledge test to earn 25 points per correct answer, up to 125 points. Points are awarded once at the end of each completed test. Tests can be repeated, have no timer, and have no penalty for wrong answers. Your points and any unfinished test are saved in this browser.

Every packet contains five independent draws, so duplicates can appear in the same pack. First choose a rarity, then a card uniformly within that rarity in the selected pool: Common 45%, Uncommon 27%, Rare 15%, Epic 8%, Legendary 4%, Archive Foil 1%. Archive Foil is reserved for a curated selection of figures with especially broad and lasting historical impact across politics, ideas, art, and music. This selection involves judgment; it is not a ranking of moral merit. Controversy alone does not qualify a card for Archive Foil. If a themed pool has no cards of a rarity, the remaining weights are normalized proportionally. Packet titles are collection labels, not praise or endorsement.

Collection progress is saved in this browser on this device. Clearing site data removes it. Export your collection to keep a backup. When moving to another site address, export from the old site and import on the new one. Imports keep the higher count for each card, so importing the same file twice does not duplicate cards. No purchases, accounts, or real money.

Portraits are sourced from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons. Open a card for its image source and licensing information. Images are cropped and displayed in grayscale; individual files retain their original licenses.
